question: A network engineer must configure Fibre Channel port monitoring for the local port. The source port should be monitored in the ingress direction. Which configuration should be implemented to achieve this objective?
options:
interface fc1/15
switchport mode SD
switchport speed 2000
no shutdown

span session 1
destination interface fc1/15
source interface fc1/16 rx

interface fc1/15
switchport mode switchport
switchport speed 2000
no shutdown

span session 1
destination interface fc1/15
source interface fc1/16 tx

interface fc1/15
switchport mode fex-fabric
switchport speed 2000
no shutdown

span session 1
destination interface fc1/15
source interface fc1/16 rx

interface fc1/15
switchport mode SD
switchport speed 2000
no shutdown

span session 1
destination interface fc1/15
source interface fc1/16 tx
theory: Monitoring the ingress direction of a source port requires a SPAN session whose source interface direction is explicitly 'rx' (ingress), pointed at a destination interface configured in SD (SPAN Destination) mode; the destination and source must be different physical interfaces (fc1/15 as SD destination, fc1/16 rx as the monitored source), and using 'tx' or leaving the destination in a non-SD switchport mode would not deliver the required ingress-only capture. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 11 - SPAN)
